messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The activation layer in a convolutional neural network uses non-linear activation functions to improve the non-linearity of the model." -- cites: E5 (Section 3.1): quote "Activation Layer. Neural networks use non-linear activation functions to improve non-linearity of models."
2. "The ReLU function is the default activation function used in popular CNNs." -- cites: E5 (Section 3.1): quote "Since ReLU (rectified linear unit) [26] is the default activation function and has the best performance in popular CNNs [18], we use it in our FALCON."
3. "The ReLU function is applied to each pixel in the input images." -- cites: E5 (Section 3.1): quote "The ReLU function is shown as follows: The output of a ReLU activation layer has the same shape as the input, which means f ( x ) is applied to each pixel in the input images."
4. "The activation layer is the second layer in the sequence of layers in a convolutional neural network." -- cites: E1 (Figure 1): observation "The figure shows the sequence of layers in a convolutional neural network, with the activation layer as the second layer."

Cited evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 1, page 4) (image attached): Figure 1: An example of convolutional neural networks.
Words printed in the figure: hf … Conv Layer 0 Activation Layer Pooling Layer flatten  FC Layer il 0l logits Softmax Softmax Layer c w f k … ReLU
[E5] (text, Section 3.1, page 3): Activation Layer. Neural networks use non-linear activation functions to improve non-linearity of models. Since ReLU (rectiﬁed linear unit) [26] is the default activation function and has the best performance in popular CNNs [18], we use it in our FALCON. The ReLU function is shown as follows: The output of a ReLU activation layer has the same shape as the input, which means f ( x ) is applied to each pixel in the input images. [image]

verdicts.reason: The evidence in E5 (Section 3.1) states that 'Activation Layer. Neural networks use non-linear activation functions to improve non-linearity of models.' This directly supports the claim that the activation layer in a convolutional neural network uses non-linear activation functions to improve the non-linearity of the model.

The evidence in E5 (Section 3.1) states that 'Since ReLU (rectified linear unit) [26] is the default activation function and has the best performance in popular CNNs [18], we use it in our FALCON.' This supports the claim that the ReLU function is the default activation function used in popular CNNs.

The evidence in E5 (Section 3.1) states that 'The ReLU function is shown as follows: The output of a ReLU activation layer has the same shape as the input, which means f ( x ) is applied to each pixel in the input images.' This supports the claim that the ReLU function is applied to each pixel in the input images.

The evidence in E1 (Figure 1) shows the sequence of layers in a convolutional neural network, with the activation layer as the second layer. This supports the claim that the activation layer is the second layer in the sequence of layers in a convolutional neural network.
